lines.en: stickbug, stickbug, ocelot\nyou won’t believe the news i’ve got
lines.zh:
竹节虫，竹节虫，豹猫
我要说的新闻你绝对想不到

lines.en: a god came down and spoke to me\ni followed it into the sea
lines.zh:
一位神降临，对我说话
我跟着它走进了海里

lines.en: stickbug, stickbug, ocelot\nmy precious little cosmonaut
lines.zh:
竹节虫，竹节虫，豹猫
我珍贵的小小宇航员

lines.en: spaceships come and spaceships go\none day you’ll say i told you so
lines.zh:
飞船来了，飞船走了
总有一天你会说，我早就告诉过你
你要接吗？
接

lines.en: You pick up the metaphorical phone.
lines.zh: 你拿起了那部隐喻意义上的电话。

lines.en: : stickbug, stickbug, ocelot\nyou won’t believe the deals we’ve got
lines.zh:
: 竹节虫，竹节虫，豹猫
我们这优惠你绝对想不到

lines.en: : I’m sorry, but I don’t want any.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我不需要。

lines.en: : half off bread and half off pie\nso cheap and fresh you’ll want to die
lines.zh:
: 面包半价，派也半价
又便宜又新鲜，新鲜到你不想活

lines.en: : I’m sorry, but I would appreciate it if you’d stop calling this place.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，但如果你们能别再往这儿打电话，我会很感激。

lines.en: : stickbug, stickbug, ocelot\nwhat happens when the raining stops?
lines.zh:
: 竹节虫，竹节虫，豹猫
雨停了会发生什么？
: 我不——

lines.en: : thunder, lightning, sometimes hail\ni’m looking for your mother’s whale
lines.zh:
: 打雷，闪电，偶尔还有冰雹
我在找你妈妈的那头鲸
不接

lines.en: oh my fucking me, are you really doing this right now? visiting your drug-addled bitch of a mother instead of sucking your teacher’s wang with so much force it pops off and gets stuck in your throat?
lines.zh: 我操，你现在真的要来这套？去看你那个毒虫婊子妈，而不是把你老师的老二用力吸到断掉、卡在你喉咙里？

lines.en: : Sure am. Or at least I would be if the key fucking worked.
lines.zh: : 是啊。或者至少在那把钥匙他妈的能用的情况下。

lines.en: : Did that bitch really change the locks on me?...
lines.zh: : 那婊子真把锁给我换了？……

lines.en: why are we here in the first place? to repay the kindness you’ve never received? because you’re sure as hell not going to fuck her. it’d be cool if you did, though. a plot twist, yeah. but cool.
lines.zh: 我们先来这儿到底是为什么？为了报答你从来没得到过的善意？因为你是绝对不会去操她的。不过你要是真干了也挺酷。算是剧情反转，没错。但很酷。

lines.en: : This fucking...does she expect me to pick the lock or something?
lines.zh: : 这他妈的……她是想让我撬锁还是怎么的？

lines.en: just a guess here, but i’m pretty sure she doesn’t expect to see you at all based on the fact that she’s actively pushing you away right now.
lines.zh: 我猜啊，她大概是压根没想到会见到你，毕竟她现在正在拼命把你推开。

lines.en: {i}A girl was at war with a thing inside of the girl and I am a new voice, not to be confused with the one who isn’t capitalizing things that are meant to be capitalized right now.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}一个女孩正跟她体内的一样东西交战，而我是个新的声音，别跟那个该大写不大写的声音搞混了。{/i}

lines.en: {i}I will not be here for long. Just long enough to guide you to the place that you are going. A special place. Good place. Made of sugar and sweat and formed into a mostly edible ball.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我不会待太久。只够把你引到你要去的那个地方。一个特别的地方。好地方。由糖和汗做成，捏成一个基本能吃的球。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Mercutio would tell you it’s no bigger than an agate stone on the fore-finger of an alderman. But unless you plan on biting off the head of the fairies’ midwife, its size matters not.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Mercutio 会告诉你，它不比市参议员食指上的一颗玛瑙大。但除非你打算咬下仙子接生婆的头，它的大小并不重要。{/i}

lines.en: {i}What matters is the taste. And how a single fleck of that sugarsalt will have you crawling back for more///even when your legs stop legging.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}重要的是味道。只要尝上一小粒那种糖盐，你就会爬回来要更多///哪怕你的腿不再当腿用了。{/i}
你刚才是不是听到了什么？

lines.en: : I hear something every second of every fucking day now thanks to you.
lines.zh: : 多亏了你，我现在每一秒都在听到什么东西。
不是我。是别的什么。是某种——
: 啊。接上了。

lines.en: : stickbug, stickbug, ocelot\nbring me all your ants.
lines.zh:
: 竹节虫，竹节虫，豹猫
把你的蚂蚁都给我带来。

lines.en: : coat their heads in sugarsalt\nstuff them in my plants
lines.zh:
: 把它们脑袋裹上糖盐
塞进我的盆栽里

lines.en: : sorry, i meant pants. stuff them in my pants.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我是说裤子。塞进我的裤子里。
哟，什么鬼？

lines.en: There’s more than just a Hall of Mirrors.
lines.zh: 可不只有一面镜子迷宫。

lines.en: I’ve heard rumors on the rapevine right next to Heaven’s Web there’s an entire world of them.
lines.zh: 我在紧挨着「天堂之网」的那根强奸藤上听说了传闻，说那里有一整个世界都是它们。

lines.en: We’d climb it in our younger days — spend hours picking leaves off — the kind that we speculated would never break our fall — yet here we are today. Silent and scared.
lines.zh: 我们年轻时会去爬它——花好几个小时摘叶子——就是那种我们猜测绝不会让我们摔下去的叶子——可今天我们还在这儿。沉默而恐惧。
有人管这叫睡觉。

lines.en: But me? I’ve always been the type to pull the petals off of whatever flowers we find in the garden. Preserve them in books so that one day, when I learn how to read, I can remember those moments.
lines.zh: 但我呢？我向来是那种把花园里找到的花瓣都揪下来的人。把它们夹在书里保存好，这样等哪天我学会认字，就能记起那些时刻。

lines.en: The ones in which everything still felt young and new. Before we lost which part of the circle we were in. Now everything feels like a barrier and we can never figure out where we started.
lines.zh: 那些一切还觉得年轻又新鲜的时刻。早在我们迷失了自己在这个圆圈里的哪一段之前。现在一切都像一道屏障，我们再也想不出自己是从哪儿开始的。

lines.en: In the beginning of someone’s end, there was little more than a ball of light.
lines.zh: 在某人结局的开端，不过是一团光。

lines.en: Mercutio would tell you it’s no bigger than an alderman on the fore-finger of an agate stone.
lines.zh: Mercutio 会告诉你，它不比玛瑙石食指上的一位市参议员大。

lines.en: But Mercutio is a liar — for I have decapitated the fairies’ midwife and placed the head of Queen Mab on a pike mere blocks from that rapevine we used to climb.
lines.zh: 但 Mercutio 是个骗子——因为我已经把仙子接生婆斩了首，把 Mab 王后的头插在长矛上，就立在我们从前爬过的那根强奸藤旁边几条街的地方。

lines.en: It is bigger now. Like us.
lines.zh: 它现在更大了。就像我们一样。

lines.en: Which is probably why we never sleep at all anymore.
lines.zh: 这大概就是我们再也不睡觉的原因。

lines.en: It’s dark beneath its shadow — and the world of mirrors reflects it every which way.
lines.zh: 它的阴影之下很黑——而镜子世界把它反射向四面八方。

lines.en: Tell me — what are {i}you{/i} afraid of?
lines.zh: 告诉我——{i}你{/i}害怕什么？

lines.en: And where would you rest in a world made of mirrors?
lines.zh: 在一个由镜子构成的世界里，你会歇在哪里？
: 这他妈的是什么……我在哪……哈？！

lines.en: One more light in the lamp — a mark on a list that grew like an ant-filled plant dancing with aunts on a ramp in a trance like an enchanted tramp clamp. So I start to recant but I can’t.
lines.zh: 灯里又多了一束光——一张清单上的一个记号，它长得像一株塞满蚂蚁的植物，在斜坡上跟姨妈们跳着舞、恍惚中像中了魔的流浪汉夹子。于是我开始反悔，可我做不到。

lines.en: And I can’t recant because of the cramps. Because my clothes are too damp. So I plug my timestamp into an amp and get gassed as the downcast grass rushes half past the outcast mast.
lines.zh: 我做不到是因为抽筋。因为我的衣服太湿。于是我把我的时间戳插进音箱，在倒伏的草丛冲过被遗弃的桅杆半刻之时被熏得够呛。

lines.en: Is it time to go to class? Never. This past surpassed cast hast been fast yet not vast. It’s a blast, this caste — full of masks and casks and masques and casques. But I just have one question to ask.
lines.zh: 该去上课了吗？永不。这过去超越了阵容，快却不广。这真是一场狂欢，这个种姓——满是面具、木桶、假面和头盔。可我只有一个问题要问。

lines.en: If Jack’s axe wants to fax some facts to the snack-shack in exchange for sacks but only receives tacks, does he tax the tacks or send them back due to cracks? It’s none of your beeswax.
lines.zh: 如果 Jack 的斧头想给小吃店发传真传点真相来换几个麻袋，却只收到图钉，他是该给图钉上税，还是因为有裂缝就退回去？这跟你半点关系都没有。

lines.en: Jack’s far too lax. He’s a failure, a quack. With a backpack full of Prozac and cognac that does naught but brush back the track I’ve been circling since this paragraph started.
lines.zh: Jack 太懒散了。他是个失败者，一个江湖郎中。背着满满一背包百忧解和干邑，除了把我从这一段开头就在绕的圈子刷回去之外屁用没有。

lines.en: I am far too old to be doing this here. I am far too young to feel fear.
lines.zh: 我太老了，不该在这儿干这个。我又太年轻，不该感到恐惧。

lines.en: But what I can do is hold your hands while you paint and try to catch the blues that never make it onto the canvas.
lines.zh: 但我能做的，是在你画画的时候握住你的手，试着去抓住那些永远上不了画布的蓝。

lines.en: {b}{size=+2}THE OCEAN IS FULL OF LIONFISH. THERE’S NO ROOM FOR ANYTHING ELSE.{/b}{/size}
lines.zh: {b}{size=+2}海里全是狮子鱼。别的什么都装不下了。{/size}{/b}

lines.en: : STICKBUG, STICKBUG, BURIED IN THE GRASS. FUCK IT IN THE PUSSY. FUCK IT IN THE ASS.
lines.zh: : 竹节虫，竹节虫，埋在草里。操它的屄。操它的屁股。

lines.en: : NO AMOUNT OF RHYMING WILL DISGUISE THE PAIN YOU FEEL AND YOU LACK THE TALENT TO ADEQUATELY DEPICT HOW YOU ARE FEELING WITHOUT A THESAURUS PRESENT.
lines.zh: : 再多的押韵也掩饰不了你感受到的痛苦，而且你缺乏在没有同义词词典在场的情况下充分描绘自己感受的才华。

lines.en: : WE HAVE AN ANNOUNCEMENT FOR YOU. VERY FRESH. VERY NEW.
lines.zh: : 我们有条公告要给你。非常新鲜。非常崭新。

lines.en: : BUT ALSO SAD BECAUSE YOU’RE BEING LEFT OUT AGAIN.
lines.zh: : 但也挺伤感，因为你又要被排除在外了。

lines.en: : THAT’S OKAY, THOUGH. ONCE MORE, YOU’LL SEE SNOW. ONCE MORE YOU WILL KNOW. BUT BY THE TIME YOU LET GO, YOUR PAIN WILL HAVE SLOWED.
lines.zh: : 没关系，不过。你会再一次见到雪。你会再一次知晓。可等你放手的时候，你的痛苦已经放缓了。

lines.en: : BUT YOU WON’T DIE ALONE. YOU JUST NEED TO MAKE IT TO THE END OF THE GAME AND HOPE THE CORRECT WORDS ARE TYPED INTO THE WORDBOX.
lines.zh: : 但你不会孤独地死去。你只需要撑到游戏结束，然后祈祷正确的词被敲进那个词框里。

lines.en: : Good morning, Yumi Yamaguchi. The time is currently 8:47 AM. Today’s weather forecast calls for highs of 78 degrees Fahrenheit and lows of 65.
lines.zh: : 早上好，Yumi Yamaguchi。现在是上午 8 点 47 分。今天的天气预报是最高 78 华氏度，最低 65 度。

lines.en: : Please be advised that your attendance is not required for the Transpacific Sadness Symposium beginning in 13 minutes as you have been identified as “tainted.”
lines.zh: : 请注意，13 分钟后开始的跨太平洋悲伤研讨会并不需要您出席，因为您已被判定为「被污染者」。

lines.en: : This is no cause for concern, though. Your guide will be here momentarily to provide you our  patented cure. In the meantime, please help yourself to an unlimited supply of fresh fish.
lines.zh: : 不过这无需担心。您的向导很快就会到，为您提供我们获得专利的疗法。在此期间，请随意享用无限量供应的鲜鱼。

lines.en: : And remember — there is no {i}you{/i} in Yumi. But there is Yumi in you.
lines.zh: : 还有请记住——「Yumi」里面没有{i}「you」{/i}。可「you」里面有 Yumi。

lines.en: : IT’S JUST LIKE WE SAID. BAD NEWS BEFORE BED. NOW YOUR THOUGHTS WILL BE PURE ‘TIL YOUR MOTHER IS DEAD.
lines.zh: : 就像我们说的那样。睡前坏消息。现在你的思绪会保持纯净，直到你妈死掉。

lines.en: : CONDOLENCES, BY THE WAY. THAT SHIT REALLY SUCKS.
lines.zh: : 顺便节哀。那事真的惨。

lines.en: : IT’S A SHAME THAT SHE’LL CROAK BEFORE THAT GUY YOU LIKE FUCKS
lines.zh: : 真遗憾，她会在你喜欢的那家伙操——
: 她之前就断气。

lines.en: : SO SCARED AND ALONE. IS THIS DREAM REALLY DREAMT? ARE THE TWO OF {i}US{/i} SUBJECT TO THE THOUGHTS THAT THIS TEMPTS?
lines.zh: : 那么害怕又孤单。这场梦真的被梦到了吗？{i}我们{/i}两个是否也受制于它所诱发的念头？

lines.en: : IT’S BECAUSE SHE IS TAINTED. HER SWEET TOOTH IS CHIPPED. ALL SHE NEEDS IS SOME CANDY TO GET BACK ON SCRIPT.
lines.zh: : 因为她被污染了。她的甜牙崩了一块。她需要的只是一点糖果，就能回到剧本上。

lines.en: : GOOD RHYME. HAVE A FISH FOR YOUR WISH DISH.
lines.zh: : 押得不错。赏你一条鱼，作为你许愿盘的奖赏。

lines.en: : NICE. I CAN’T WAIT TO SQUISH THIS.
lines.zh: : 漂亮。我等不及要把它捏爆了。

lines.en: : What the fuck what the fuck what the fuck what the fuck what the fuck what the fuck what the fuck what the fuck what the fuck what the fuck what the fuck ???????
lines.zh: : 什么鬼什么鬼什么鬼什么鬼什么鬼什么鬼什么鬼什么鬼什么鬼什么鬼什么鬼什么鬼 ???????

lines.en: : What the fuck what the fuck what the fuck what the-
lines.zh: : 什么鬼什么鬼什么鬼什么鬼什——

lines.en: : Cure me of...of what? {i}You’re{/i} the one who needs to be cured! {i}You’re{/i} the one who-
lines.zh: : 治好我……治好什么？需要被治好的是{i}你{/i}！是{i}你{/i}——

lines.en: : I already feel alive! {i}Too{/i} alive! If anything, I want to feel {i}less!{/i} I’m tired of feeling at all! It’s all just fucking anger and sadness and betrayal and-
lines.zh: : 我已经感觉活着了！活{i}过头{/i}了！要说有什么，我倒是想{i}少{/i}感觉一点！我受够了感觉！全都是他妈的愤怒、悲伤、背叛，还有——
: 你其实不是她……对吧？

lines.en: : Can you tell me {i}what{/i} you are then?...What {i}this{/i} is? Because if this is another fucking Pareidolia thing-
lines.zh: : 那你能告诉我你是{i}什么{/i}吗？……{i}这{/i}是什么？因为如果这又是他妈的那个 Pareidolia 之类的——
: 拿……什么？

lines.en: : Then why don’t you eat it yourself?...Why are you only worried about curing me?...
lines.zh: : 那你自己为什么不吃？……为什么你只担心治好我？……
: 我只是……
: {i}我不想让你死。{/i}

lines.en: : So if {i}I{/i} take that...{i}you{/i} live forever? Is that...is this another fucking...time thing?! Is this something that’s supposed to happen?! Is {i}this{/i} what Sensei’s seeing every time he-
lines.zh: : 所以如果{i}我{/i}吃了那个……{i}你{/i}就能永远活着？这是不是……这又是他妈的什么……时间循环的东西？！{i}这{/i}就是 Sensei 每次他——的时候看到的那种东西吗？！

lines.en: : I’m so proud of you, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 我真为你骄傲，Yumi。
: Sensei？……
: 你现在也在这儿了？……

lines.en: : What are you talking about? I’ve always been here. I’ve always been watching. Which is why I’m so proud of you.
lines.zh: : 你在说什么？我一直都在这儿。我一直在看着。所以我才这么为你骄傲。

lines.en: : All that you’ve accomplished...all that you’ve worked for...you’ve come so far.
lines.zh: : 你完成的一切……你为之努力的一切……你已经走了这么远。

lines.en: : And all it took was for your illness to be cured. To think it was something so simple that had been holding you back.
lines.zh: : 而这一切只需要你的病被治好。想想看，一直拖你后腿的竟是这么简单的东西。
: 可是我……我没有……

lines.en: : I haven’t done anything! Anything at all! I’ve barely changed since-
lines.zh: : 我什么都没做到！一件都没有！我从那之后几乎没变过——

lines.en: : Just think...how much would you be capable of if you took even more?
lines.zh: : 想想看……如果你再多来一点，你能做到多少？

lines.en: : I wish that could be me — so unbothered by the world around me that it’s barely even a factor.
lines.zh: : 我真希望我也能那样——对周围的世界毫不在意，在意到它几乎都不算个因素。
: 我敬佩你。不……
: 我{i}爱{/i}你，Yumi。

lines.en: : Please — accept these. These are my body. Take it and eat. Take it and become a better you.
lines.zh: : 求你了——收下这些。这是我的身体。拿去吃吧。吃了它，变成更好的你。

lines.en: : Am I not good enough the way I am now?...{i}Outside{/i} of this...surreal fantasy you’ve all pulled me into?
lines.zh: : 我现在这样就还不够好吗？……在你们把我拖进的这个……超现实幻想{i}之外{/i}？

lines.en: : Of course not. No one is.
lines.zh: : 当然不够。没有人是够的。

lines.en: : Which is why we must rely on other things. Which is why we hide ourselves in what we do or {i}who{/i} we do.
lines.zh: : 所以我们才必须依赖别的东西。所以我们才把自己藏在我们做的事、或者我们操的{i}人{/i}里。

lines.en: : But can you imagine a world where you and I could be that for {i}each other?{/i}
lines.zh: : 但你能想象一个你我能成为{i}彼此{/i}的那个东西的世界吗？
: 不……我想象不出来……

lines.en: : Then take me and eat me. {i}Make{/i} it possible.
lines.zh: : 那就把我拿去吃了吧。{i}让{/i}它成为可能。

lines.en: : Everything you could ever need is right there in your hands.
lines.zh: : 你可能需要的一切，就在你手里。

lines.en: : Happy birthday, Yumi. We’ve been waiting for you.
lines.zh: : 生日快乐，Yumi。我们一直在等你。

lines.en: : Come. Fill your hands with the candy we’ve so gleefully gathered and dumped into these festive bowls for you.
lines.zh: : 来吧。把你手里装满我们欢欢喜喜收集起来、倒进这些节日碗里的糖果。
: 我亲手挑的。

lines.en: : What’s the matter? Haven’t you ever seen two talking faces on a chalkboard in the dark before?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？你以前从没在黑暗里见过黑板上两张会说话的脸吗？

lines.en: : As a matter of fact, I can’t say I have.
lines.zh: : 说实话，还真没有。

lines.en: : Don’t mind Right Face — he’s always been a bit of a joker. Regardless, won’t you celebrate with us?
lines.zh: : 别理右脸——他一向有点爱开玩笑。总之，你不跟我们一起庆祝吗？

lines.en: : We’ve waited so very long for you, after all.
lines.zh: : 毕竟我们等了你那么久。

lines.en: : Even when the others told us not to.
lines.zh: : 就算别人叫我们别等。

lines.en: : Shh. She doesn’t need to know about that.
lines.zh: : 嘘。她不需要知道那个。

lines.en: : You two know my birthday isn’t until Halloween, right?...It’s the middle of June right now.
lines.zh: : 你们俩知道我的生日要到万圣节才到吧？……现在才六月中旬。
: 在这里，永远是万圣节。

lines.en: : Which means that every day, you’ll grow some more. Numerically and mentally. Mostly numerically. That number would grow quite large rather quickly, wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: : 也就是说，每一天，你都会长大一点。数字上和心智上。主要是数字上。那个数字会相当快地变得相当大，不是吗？

lines.en: : But where {i}is{/i} here?...What is this place? And where did my mom go? Where did {i}Sensei{/i} go?!
lines.zh: : 可是这里是哪儿？……这是什么地方？我妈去哪儿了？{i}Sensei{/i} 去哪儿了？！

lines.en: : Dead, presumably. They’d have existed thousands of years ago at this point.
lines.zh: : 大概死了吧。在这个时间点上，他们应该已经存在了几千年。

lines.en: : The fuck do you mean “thousands of years ago?!” How am I still here then?!
lines.zh: : 你他妈的说什么「几千年前」？！那我怎么还在这儿？！

lines.en: : Time doesn’t move here. At least not in the traditional sense.
lines.zh: : 这里时间不流动。至少不是传统意义上的那种。

lines.en: : We came up with our own calendar because time is a man-made construct, then rearranged it to have every day as October 31st — the human Halloween.
lines.zh: : 我们自己搞出了一套历法，因为时间是人为的构造，然后我们把它重排了一遍，让每一天都是 10 月 31 日——人类的万圣节。

lines.en: : We’ve also extended days to what would be considered about thirty hours each where you’re from so that everyone can get eight hours of sleep.
lines.zh: : 我们还把一天延长到你们那边大约三十小时，这样每个人都能睡够八小时。

lines.en: : But no one ages. And everything outside of here is exactly the same as it has always been.
lines.zh: : 但没有谁会变老。这里之外的一切都跟从前一模一样。

lines.en: : Probably. We’re two faces on a chalkboard, so all we know is what we’ve heard from others.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。我们只是黑板上的两张脸，所以我们知道的都是从别人那儿听来的。
: 还有……别人？……

lines.en: : Your entire family is here. Those who came after, at least.
lines.zh: : 你全家都在这儿。至少是后来的那些。

lines.en: : Hundreds and hundreds of descendants — each with your eyes. And they all have a piece of you in them.
lines.zh: : 成百上千的后代——每一个都有你的眼睛。他们身上都有一部分你。

lines.en: : Mostly due to inbreeding. But we’d be lying if we said the vast majority didn’t also have some sort of genetic makeup causing them to act like delinquents more often than not.
lines.zh: : 多半是因为近亲繁殖。不过要是我们说绝大多数人没有某种让他们动不动就像不良少女的基因构成，那我们就是在撒谎。
: 所以你们俩是……算是……

lines.en: : Gods, I suppose you’d call us.
lines.zh: : 神吧，我想你会这么叫。

lines.en: : Very specific and very weak ones. But gods nonetheless.
lines.zh: : 非常具体、也非常弱小的神。但终究是神。

lines.en: : I am Migi, the God of Chalk.
lines.zh: : 我是 Migi，粉笔之神。

lines.en: : And I am Hidari, the God of Black-Haired Tsundere Girls.
lines.zh: : 我是 Hidari，黑发傲娇少女之神。

lines.en: : You can be a god too, you know.
lines.zh: : 你也可以当神，你知道吗。

lines.en: : You practically already {i}are.{/i} The others here view you as such anyway. You just need to ascend.
lines.zh: : 你基本上已经{i}是{/i}了。这里的其他人就是这么看你的。你只需要飞升。

lines.en: : And fill out the appropriate paperwork.
lines.zh: : 再填好相应的 paperwork。

lines.en: : Migi can help with that. He {i}is{/i} the God of Chalk after all.
lines.zh: : Migi 可以帮你。他毕竟{i}是{/i}粉笔之神。

lines.en: : So what do you say, Yumi? Will you stay?
lines.zh: : 那么你觉得呢，Yumi？你要留下吗？

lines.en: : Will you celebrate your birthday with us?
lines.zh: : 你要跟我们一起过生日吗？

lines.en: : We’ll wait as long as it takes.
lines.zh: : 等多久我们都愿意。

lines.en: : Go on — help yourself to some candy in the meantime.
lines.zh: : 去吧——这期间随便吃点糖果。

lines.en: : Thanks, but I’m...not really into the whole “god” thing.
lines.zh: : 谢了，不过我……对「神」这套真的没兴趣。

lines.en: : Not even me? But I’m so specifically tailored to you. What else would you rather believe?
lines.zh: : 连我都不行？可我是专门为你量身定制的。你还想信点别的什么？

lines.en: : I don’t know. Nothing, I guess?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。什么都不信吧，大概？

lines.en: : But if you don’t believe in anything-
lines.zh: : 可如果你什么都不信——
{b}{size=+10}这里根本什么都没有{/size}{/b}

lines.en: okay fine, i’ll go first. what the fuck just happened?
lines.zh: 好吧行吧，我先来。刚才他妈的发生什么了？

lines.en: : Are you telling me you {i}don’t{i} know?
lines.zh: : 你是说你{i}不知道{/i}？

lines.en: uhhh, yeah? it takes a lot to completely cut off my consciousness. i was worried for a second there that you just randomly stopped believing in me.
lines.zh: : 呃，对啊？能把我意识完全切断的事可不多。我刚才有一瞬间还担心你突然就不相信我了。
: 我本来就{i}不{/i}相信你啊。
: 你信的，Yumi。
: 至少现在是。

lines.en: so tell me — what did you see? what sort of stuff are you hiding from your old pal here?
lines.zh: : 那么告诉我——你看到了什么？你对老朋友藏了些什么东西？
: 没什么……
: 我什么都没看到。

lines.en: : I’m just...gonna open the door and-
lines.zh: : 我这就……去开门，然后——

lines.en: : Wait, didn’t I unlock it? Just a minute ago, I unlocked it...right? Right?
lines.zh: : 等等，我刚不是开锁了吗？就一分钟前，我开了锁……对吧？对吧？

lines.en: how the fuck would i know? i don’t have hands. and trust me — you’d know if i did. those double d’s down there are practically begging to be fondled.
lines.zh: 我他妈的怎么知道？我又没有手。而且相信我——我要是有手，你早就知道了。下面那对 D 罩杯简直在求着被摸。
